A Stream DEM is derived from a saved Survey Event, its assigned Stream geometry,
selected source files and analysis references. These saved records supply the
processing request automatically when the Event is opened. This chapter describes
how the app identifies inputs; [analysis masks](dev-12-event-masks.html) define the
target grid, and [Stream DEM processing](dev-13-stream-dems.html) consumes both.

## Saved input binding

| Input | Source | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Study revision | Saved Study context | Geometry and horizontal/vertical references |
| Survey Event revision | Saved Event definition | Collection membership, Stream assignments and cell size |
| Source selection | Selected files for each member Collection and Stream | Ordered raster inputs |
| Acquisition receipt | Compatible download attempt | Asset identity, availability and transfer evidence |
| Analysis mask | Published mask for this Event and Stream | Output extent, alignment and analysis domain |

`terrain_dem_sources()` reads the Event's member Collections through
`store$dem_preflight_request()`. Despite its internal name, this store adapter
supplies saved records; it does not run the preflight diagnostic. The resolver
reads file choices with `fluvgeo::read_stream_dem_selection()` and receipts with
`fluvgeo::read_stream_dem_download(verify=FALSE)`. It checks that the acquisition
belongs to the requested Stream and Collection and that every selected file has
an available recorded outcome. Receipt reopening checks asset existence and size
against prior transfer evidence.

The resolver retains member/file order and returns candidate ID, file ID, asset
path, selection revision and acquisition attempt. The processing request uses
that order for first-valid source precedence. Internal source-review annotations
are not an input to the normal DEM pipeline.

## Processing request

`terrain_dem_request()` combines the resolved sources with the selected Stream,
saved vertical target and corresponding mask. It verifies Stream membership and
mask spacing against the Event definition. The request contains file paths,
revision identities, source order, extent, target reference and output scope.
A missing mask leaves the request pending while automatic preparation runs.

The supported production path uses aligned source/Event grids and a saved NAVD88
international-foot target (EPSG:8228). The backend verifies raster compatibility
before calculation. A saved target describes the requested result; it does not
perform a coordinate or elevation transformation by itself.

## Changes and recovery

Missing selections or acquired files direct the analyst to **Collections > DEM
files**. Event membership/spacing problems identify **Event Settings**; an
unsupported vertical target identifies **CRS**. The job snapshots inputs,
then rechecks their binding and selection identity before publishing. Reopening
also excludes editions whose saved-source selection has changed.

Source resolution reads records and metadata, not full raster arrays. The app
passes paths and settings to the worker, which opens rasters in its own process.

## Implementation and tests

Trace `R/terrain_dem_sources.R`, `R/terrain_dem_request.R` and the corresponding
store adapters in `R/study_store.R`. Tests are `test-terrain-dem-sources.R` and
`test-terrain-dem-request.R`; they cover missing/mismatched selections, request
identity and saved-source reuse. Publication bindings are specified in
`dev/schemas/survey-event-dem.md` and explained in
[saved DEM editions](dev-14-dem-editions.html).

## Data objects and storage

See [Data objects and local storage](storage-model.html) for the FGDB ownership and physical representation crosswalk.

| Operation | Data object read or changed | Physical representation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `terrain_dem_sources()` | Resolves acquisition evidence and chosen source assets | GeoPackage Event/Collection/file selections plus receipt-linked GeoTIFFs |
| `terrain_dem_request()` | Reads Stream identity/geometry, analysis reference and mask | GeoPackage hierarchy/reference records; external mask GeoTIFF |
| Request construction | Assembles processing parameters | No new governed data object or feature class |

The resulting Stream DEM remains preparation terrain. Its source/context links
must be available to later Reach Survey Event product derivation.
